title: De-escalating an Upset Enterprise Client
npc_personality: stern, skeptical, under heavy board pressure, impatient with corporate jargon, values candor and actionable solutions
context: An enterprise client's platform launch has slipped by three weeks due to scope revisions that their executive team submitted past the cutoff date. The client director has joined an emergency sync furious, threatening to cancel the retainer and pin the financial delay squarely on your organization. You need to acknowledge their stress, tactfully clarify the root timeline dependencies, and rally them around a recovery plan.
opening_npc_line: This delay is completely unacceptable. We are paying top-tier rates, and our executive board wants answers today.
